location.locationEvidence: All three official SBI files explicitly name Kalavakkam and repeat the same scheme, villa, block, door, land-share and super-built-up areas. MITO links the exact village name to current registration village 20096:1318 while preserving the historical Thiruporur and Kancheepuram labels.
location.positionalUncertainty: No source coordinate or verified parcel polygon was published. The project, villa, block, door and survey references remain location evidence, but MITO does not substitute a project, street or village centroid.

asset.assetDescription: Attached villa with an undivided share in the parent land
asset.schemeNameSource: The Village by Phoneix Hodu Developers
asset.possessionEvidence: SBI states physical possession was taken on 2022-09-23.

records.priceTypeLabel: Official secured-creditor combined villa-and-UDS auction reserve
records.scopeCaveat: The reserve combines a completed villa and its undivided land share. Both derived denominators are comparison-only combined-reserve densities, not land value, building value, a sale price or a Kalavakkam market rate.

records.priceTypeLabel: Official secured-creditor combined villa-and-UDS re-auction reserve
records.scopeCaveat: The lower later floor is for the same combined villa-and-UDS asset. It does not prove the prior auction failed, a completed sale, land value or a general market movement.

laterLifecycleEvidence.sameAssetEvidence: Scheme, phase, villa, block, door, Kalavakkam place label, 2,000 sq-ft undivided land share, 2,705 sq-ft super-built-up area and physical-possession date agree.
laterLifecycleEvidence.interpretation: The later official schedule shows that SBI issued another sale notice for the same possessed asset. It does not establish a new price, failed earlier auction, current availability or completed sale.

reconciliation.sameAssetEvidence: Scheme, phase, villa, block, door, land-share area, super-built-up area, parent survey schedule and physical-possession date agree across both priced terms documents.
reconciliation.priceInterpretation: Both floors include the villa and undivided land share. Dividing by either published area produces only a comparison denominator and cannot isolate land or building value.
reconciliation.lifecycleConclusion: Two price checkpoints and one later unpriced sale-notice schedule are verified. No winning bid, sale certificate, registered transfer, current ownership or current availability is verified.

publicationRule: These are two historical auction floors for one exact-village Kalavakkam villa-and-undivided-land-share asset, plus one later unpriced official sale-notice schedule. Any per-square-foot result is a comparison-only combined-reserve density using a disclosed denominator; it is not a land rate or building-only value. The evidence must never be relabelled as a winning bid, completed or registered sale, guideline value, asking price, market estimate, current availability or a village-wide Kalavakkam rate. The asset remains unplotted because no verified coordinate or parcel geometry was published.
